summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a 16-year colocation lease and services agreement for its Tydal, Norway data center. The counterparty is Volta Tydal AS, a subsidiary of Volta, with the end customer a leading AI lab. The deal represents approximately $4.7 billion in contracted revenue over 16 years, with an 8-year extension option potentially reaching $8.0 billion. The structure is a modified gross lease averaging about $202/kW/month, with electricity pass-through. Credit support of roughly $1.3 billion in letters of credit is expected from J.P. Morgan affiliates and another institution. This is an ordinary commercial contract, not a special situation.
